subject: A quiet note about a date on your example file
body:
Hello. We hope this note is easy to set aside until you have a free minute. It still has a date on it, and the date matters.

The only missing page is a short note of the months you worked for the example city school. The rest of the file is complete enough to rate, and the rater will use it as it stands once the window ends.

Whenever it is convenient, please send the page. The response window closes on March 25, 2026, and after that the file may be finished without it. We would rather have your note than guess.

label: INFORMATIONAL
subject: Your statement is ready, use the new login link
body:
This softer lure imitates a statement-ready note. The underlying topic sounds informational, and the link is the trap.

The lure says a retired-pay statement is ready to view and that the usual site is down for the weekend. It suggests a temporary page instead.

Open http://mypay.secure-update.example.com/login to see the statement. The host is synthetic and should be treated as suspicious even though no payment is asked.

This message is a synthetic example created for a sorting demonstration and is not an official VA, DFAS, or insurer notice.
